name: TCL 55P638
summary: TCL 55P638 ships with TCL analytics, content feeds and promos. TidyTV is a free phone app that turns them off, with a backup and one-tap undo.
intro: This TCL runs Android TV 11 and ships with TCL analytics and logging, plus content feeds, promos and optional vendor services such as a guard cleaner, a store demo sticker, a message box and a TCL account app. Google extras, preloaded streaming apps and a preloaded browser add more.

Apps staying off and the clean home screen were verified after a reboot. The preloaded browser was turned off afterward, and the owner confirmed normal TV operation. TidyTV turns the apps off from your phone over Wi-Fi, saves a backup first and never deletes anything.
keep: The Google TV home, until a replacement is installed
Live TV and the TCL input apps
notes: The setup app may hold your saved Wi-Fi. Check that before turning it off.
Several apps, such as voice assistants and streaming apps, are off by the owner's choice.

faq.q: Will the voice button still work on my TCL 55P638?
faq.a: Not with the default list. The voice assistants are off by the owner's choice. Switch them back on in the app if you use voice.

faq.q: Will it stop the ads on the home screen?
faq.a: It turns off the TCL content feeds and promos, plus the Google extras and preload setup apps.

faq.q: Can I get the old home screen back?
faq.a: Yes. Restore everything turns every app back on and puts the stock Google TV home screen back.
